title: Paul Kadot
body: Look no further, friend! This is the habit tracker you need
author: Paul Kadot

title: Just found out about HabitKit from Threads
body:
I was looking for a simple and minimal habit tracker with exactly this kind of GUI. And here it is!

Can’t wait for it to integrate with the Health app or nutritional apps like Cronometer.
author: AveaCallist

title: Great for improving habits!
body: Downloaded this app after reading the book Atomic Habits. I used pen and paper to analyse current habits and which i need to improve. Once i figured which habits to focus on, i wrote them down in the app. Great for habit implementation and habit stacking. The app has a flawless design, is motivating and honest. Its simple, easy and straight forward.
author: Alexandra989

title: I like it
body: Only used it for 10 minutes, but the aesthetic and the minimalist feel is really nice. Good app, might upgrade to pro.
author: Schulstad

title: Simple, but hits the spots
body: Everything you need in a habit tracker. No extra wizz wazz stuff.
author: LoverBoy97
